mechanism_narrative: A increase in GDP growth rate signals a strong economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive during periods of high unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong economy, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts and an increase in GDP growth rate signal a shift in consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative during periods of high GDP growth and low housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the consumer price index signal an easing monetary cycle with high inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during periods of low interest rates and high inflation.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of high employment and low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales and an increase in GDP growth rate signal a shift in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during periods of low retail sales and high GDP growth.
